name: pi-odd-worktree
description: Pi package for odd-worktree: the Git worktree tools a Pi session uses (create and list the checkouts the agent works in), the /warp worktree panel, the /odd ODD viewer, and the /issues GitHub issue reader. Needs only Pi and git: no companion app, no extra
